reason: B proposes a genuinely new, testable Mn substitution and compares coercivity against the relevant FeCoNiPd/Pt baselines, with a physically plausible—though incompletely substantiated—pinning/competing-exchange mechanism. A simply reproposes FeCoNiPt despite the premise that it is soft, uses FeCoNi rather than the prior derivatives as its baseline, and assumes unsupported single-phase L1₀ ordering in an equiatomic quaternary alloy.
